question: What bonds and principles arise from the world called the body-bond upward?
premises: Beginning from the world called the body-bond, the qualities of intellect come next.
In that same domain the ego appears as eightfold and in three ways.
Bonds beginning with desire also arise there.
inference: Above the body-bond world unfold intellect, a differentiated ego, and desire-based bonds.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eightfold and threefold divisions is compressed in the verse.
plain_english: Starting from the world called the body-bond, the qualities of intellect appear. There the ego is present in eightfold and threefold forms, along with bonds beginning with desire.
